sentences.en: It's a mixture of ceramics, porcelain, stoneware, and earthenware.
sentences.zh: 它是由陶器、瓷器、炻器和黏土器皿混合而成的。

sentences.en: Archeologists found many ceramic artifacts at that archeological site.
sentences.zh: 考古学家在那个考古遗址发现了许多陶器制品。

sentences.en: Jack has a ceramic piggy bank in which he saves coins.
sentences.zh: 杰克有一个存钱罐，是用陶器做的，他把硬币放在里面保存起来。

senses.zh: 陶器的；陶瓷的；制陶艺术的 -
陶瓷制品；陶瓷 形容词: ceramic
